description: Risk of Flooding from Reservoirs - Maximum Flood Speed (Web Mapping Service) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment Agency. This dataset is now retired and replaced with the following: Reservoir Flood Extents - Fluvial Contribution (National) Reservoir Flood Extents - Wet Day (National) Reservoir Flood Extents - Dry Day (National) This is the simplified version of the outline Reservoir Flood Map Outline (Speed) as shown on the gov.uk Flood Risk website. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environment Agency. Its tags are OpenData, flooding, mapping, model, reservoir. The portal shows 2021-11-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
